method: Independently checked each current canonical note has exactly one marked English card image; its resolved path, decoded PNG, dimensions, exact SHA256, paper source identity and preserved detailed-body hash match its unique progress/inventory record. scope_note: This final audit verifies collection integration and assets. Per-paper source/image reviews are recorded in their batch audits; it does not newly re-review PDFs or scientific claims of all 337 notes.

publication_evidence.method: The 44 newly integrated cards and corrected SAMV-DUSt3R image were fetched from immutable main with matching hashes and marked note/source links.
